title: CIA-UAP-010, Report on Conversations with Soviet Scientists on Subject of Unidentified Flying Objects in the USSR
doc_notes: This is a CIA intelligence report summarizing conversations with Soviet scientists regarding their views and observations of UFOs; it contains one report of a sighting by astronomers.

encounters.summary: Astronomers I.K. Koval and L.I. Galkin observed a curious, reddish object flashing through the sky while in the countryside near Kiev, which they could not identify as a satellite or meteorite.
encounters.quote: seen a curious, reddish object flashing through the sky
